channel.title: National Oil And Lube News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from National Oil And Lube News (noln.net)

item.title: Workforce Pell Grant Program: How Automotive Apprentices Could Be Covered Under the New Initiative
item.description: A new Pell Grant program this summer will provide funds to short-term track programs in industries including automotive service and repair.

item.title: The Plan to Expand
item.description: Quick lube operators who have successfully built large portfolios through new construction and acquisitions of existing shops share insights on what it takes to grow.

item.title: New Keys, New Energy: Couple Finds Success in First Months as Owners of Performance Fast Lube
item.description: When Jodi and Ron Gathercole’s first grandchild was born on the East Coast, they made the move from Houston to the small town of Moncks Corner, South Carolina, and finally made their dreams reality.

item.title: Podcast | Fearless to Courageous (with Chris Messer, Mike Jones, James Baxter, and Hunter Barton)
item.description: Representatives from Neighborhood Tire Pros in Atlanta discuss leadership, courage, and how a business that faced hard times was revived and now thrives.

item.title: Quick Lube Q&A: Bill O’Ryan, American Petroleum Institute
item.description: American Petroleum Institute Director Bill O’Ryan shares insights on the development of ILSAC GF-8, a new category of car engine oil targeted for launch in late 2028

item.title: NOLN News Quiz: How are Shops Delivering Deals?
item.description: Think you know the most popular method quick lube operators rely on to offer discounts to their customers? Take our quiz and find out!

item.title: Counting Cars
item.description: Car count is a classic KPI for quick lube operators, and among respondents to the 2025 NOLN Operator Survey, between 20 and 39 is the sweet spot for number of vehicles serviced per day.

item.title: ASE Launches its ASE Test Prep Partner Initiative
item.description: ASE's latest program aims to elevate the standards of automotive technician certification by identifying trusted Test Prep Partners.

item.title: Podcast | Getting Everyone on Track: Keys for Building Staff Alignment Within Your Shop (with Sara Welch and Mike Mooney)
item.description: Learn strategies for motivating your team members and aligning their personal goals with those of your shop.

item.title: Motor Age Training Becomes an Official ASE Test Prep Partner
item.description: The collaboration strengthens Motor Age Training's mission to support automotive professionals nationwide, providing validated study guides and practice tests that meet ASE's rigorous standards for technician certification.
